commentary: The Nifty 50 decisively reclaimed technical leadership with a 1.14% expansion past recent congestion, propelled by broad institutional participation and massive FII accumulation. However, a breadth score of 49% signals internal crosscurrents beneath headline index strength, echoing Stan Weinstein's warning to differentiate true Stage 2 market leaders from broad-market laggards. In strict alignment with William O'Neil's CANSLIM discipline, a general market follow-through demands rigorous fundamental confirmation: capital must be aggressively concentrated only in high-relative-strength leaders exhibiting superior earnings acceleration and volume-backed pivot breakouts, while candidates carrying decelerating earnings or unproven bottom-line expansion must be restricted to cautious observation.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

63MOONS.technical: Forming a 23.8% deep cup with a 10.5% handle above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Handle displays pronounced volume dry-up, but upper resistance near 982.83 requires volume-backed breakout confirmation.
63MOONS.fundamental: Despite triple-digit top-line growth (+131.7%), persistent net losses (Q2 EPS -₹6.24) and negative ROCE (-3.7%) fail O'Neil's C+A criteria. The balance sheet is essentially debt-free, but lack of operating profitability caps institutional sponsorship.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown below handle support at 892.13 violates structural integrity, requiring immediate capital exit.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volume expanded 1.19x on the latest upswing, while RSI at 60 demonstrates constructive non-extended momentum below the 116.92 neckline pivot.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Modest top-line growth of 5.3% and sub-20% EPS expansion fail CANSLIM benchmarks. Sub-3% operating profit margins and a depressed 3-year ROE (3.2%) highlight structural profitability constraints despite minimal debt leverage.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Violation of the 106.63 pivot support invalidates the double-bottom pattern, triggering immediate stop discipline.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 leadership profile. Base displays a 22.8% cup with a constructive 4.2% high-tight handle above rising key moving averages. MACD remains bullish above the zero line as price tests all-time highs.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Superb CANSLIM candidate. Standalone PAT surged 180% to ₹65.75 crore with revenue advancing 46.8%, driven by doubling CDMO revenues. EBITDA margins expanded to 22.2%, with debt-to-equity manageable at 0.40 and expanding ROCE.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Failure below the 967.84 handle stop level signals a false breakout; cut losses ruthlessly.

AARTISURF.technical: Power breakout characteristics emerging from a double-bottom base with 1.53x volume surge. Trading well above rising 50 and 200 SMAs; RSI at 71 reflects decisive relative strength leadership without parabolic blow-off.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Phenomenal earnings acceleration with Q2 EPS leaping to ₹14.85 from ₹1.92, accompanied by 62.6% sales growth. Operating margins widened sharply to 10.3%, cash conversion improved to 38 days, and debt/equity moderated to 0.43.
AARTISURF.risk: Breach below the 564.20 double-bottom swing pivot invalidates the breakout thesis; enforce stop immediately.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Consolidating tightly within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot, respecting the rising 21 EMA and 50 SMA. Neckline pressure and positive MACD alignment indicate orderly accumulation ahead of the 420.42 trigger level.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Quality institutional financials setup. Consolidated sales grew 32.2% with net profit expanding 37.9% to ₹1,353 crore. Underwriting turnaround in health insurance and 32% lending AUM growth provide robust multi-quarter fundamental backing.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A drop below the 396.98 consolidation base pivot breaks trend alignment, requiring automatic risk cut.

ABDL.technical: Developing a double-bottom structure clearing minor resistance on 1.27x volume. Price maintains position above key moving averages with positive MACD divergence, but requires confirmation above the 855.55 trigger level.
ABDL.fundamental: Operations generated record volumes (10m cases) and 15.8% sales growth, but profit growth remains subdued at 9.7% following a negative Q1. Compressed net margins (~3.3%) and high P/E (>95x) require fundamental stabilization.
ABDL.risk: Close below 795.07 invalidates the double-bottom base structure, requiring strict adherence to stop loss.
